landing.meta_description: Simple smart tools for farmers to grow better crops.
landing.hero_subtitle: We use simple smart tech to help you understand your soil and grow more. We want every farmer to succeed with the right information at the right time.
landing.yield_increase_desc: How much more crop you might get with our help.
landing.algorithms_desc: Our tool understands how soil works, just like you do. We help keep your land healthy for a long time.
landing.process_step_1_desc: Satellite data from NASA and soil intelligence from Google Earth Engine are collected for your exact coordinates.
landing.process_step_2_desc: Our Hybrid PyTorch models analyze leaf images and climate vectors using ResNet and DenseNet architectures.
landing.process_step_3_desc: Receive clear, jargon-free advice from Kissan Mitra (Gemini AI) for immediate field decisions.
landing.satellite_desc: Hyper-local soil analysis for N, P, K, Carbon and pH levels.
landing.ai_mentor_desc: Providing contextual farming insights in multi-lingual natural language.

yield.awaiting_params: Waiting for your farm details to calculate results.

crop.description: Our smart tool checks your soil and weather to tell you which crops will grow best and give you the most profit on your land.
crop.adaptability_note: These crops are picked because they like your current soil Type
crop.potential_note: Growing the Best Choice may give you the most crop.
crop.initialize_engine: Enter your soil details to see which crops are best for your land.

fertilizer.description: We check your soil's health to tell you exactly how much fertilizer to use for healthy crops.
fertilizer.placeholder: Results will show up here after you click the button above.

support.title: Govt Helper Schemes
support.description: Information about simple help systems and money help from the government for farmers.

pm_kisan.title: PM-KISAN
pm_kisan.objective: To give direct money help to small farmers.
pm_kisan.benefits: ₹6,000 every year directly to your bank account.

pmfby.title: Crop Insurance (PMFBY)
pmfby.objective: Money help if your crop is damaged by rain or storm.
pmfby.benefits: Low cost insurance to get your money back if crop fails.

kcc.title: Krishi Loan (KCC)
kcc.objective: To give easy and fast loan support from banks.
kcc.benefits: Loans up to ₹3 lakh at very low interest rates.

pmksy.title: Water Help (PMKSY)
pmksy.objective: Help to get water to your crops more easily.
pmksy.benefits: Subsidies for drip and sprinkler pipes (More Crop Per Drop).

enam.title: Online Mandi (e-NAM)
enam.objective: Sell your crops online to get the best price.
enam.benefits: See fair prices and avoid middlemen.

soil_health.title: Soil Health Card
soil_health.objective: Simple report of your soil type and what it needs.
soil_health.benefits: Free soil test and tips on which fertilizer is best.

rkvy.title: Agri Business Help
rkvy.objective: Help to start new farming businesses.
rkvy.benefits: Grants and money to start storage or agri-business.

aif.title: Storage Help (AIF)
aif.objective: Money help for cold storage and warehouses.
aif.benefits: Low interest loans to build storage for your crops.

pkvy.title: Organic Farming (PKVY)
pkvy.objective: Support for natural and organic farming.
pkvy.benefits: Money help and training to grow crops without chemicals.

pmmsy.title: Fisheries (PMMSY)
pmmsy.objective: Help for fish farming and related work.
pmmsy.benefits: Subsidies for fish ponds and transport vans.

crop_disease_page.title: Plant Health Check
crop_disease_page.description: Upload a photo of a leaf to see if your plant is sick and get simple tips to fix it.
crop_disease_page.upload_desc: Just take a clear photo of the leaf (Max size 10MB)
crop_disease_page.no_image: Please upload a leaf photo to start the check.
crop_disease_page.error_upload: Could not check image. Please try again.
crop_disease_page.prevention_desc: Give plants space and don't pour too much water on leaves.
